# AI Review Panel

## Summary
A side panel for checking values the model extracted from a source document. Each field is a collapsible card showing the extracted value, the model's reasoning, and the exact passages it relied on. Hovering a passage highlights it in the source; clicking scrolls to it. The user accepts or dismisses each field, or applies every pending one at once, and a segmented status bar and filter tabs show how much is left to review.

## When to use
- Document extraction: contracts, regulatory notices, invoices, filings, medical or insurance forms, where each value must be traceable to the text.
- Reviews where the user is accountable for the result and needs to see *why* the model chose a value, not just the value.
- Long sources where finding the supporting passage by hand would take longer than checking it.

## When not to use
- Values with no single source passage (summaries, sentiment, scores). Show reasoning in a trace instead.
- Enrichment from the open web, where the user mostly fills empty fields. Use AI Fill Drawer.
- One or two fields. Inline suggestions next to the input are lighter than a panel.
- When values can be edited freely and checked later. Without an accountable review step, the per-field ceremony is overhead.

## Anatomy
- **Header** — ✦ title, "View source", close.
- **Status bar** — a segmented bar, one segment per status (dismissed, pending, accepted), each sized by its share of fields, with "N of M reviewed".
- **Filter tabs** — All, Pending, Accepted, Dismissed, each with a count badge tinted in its status color.
- **Search** — filters by field name or value.
- **Field card** — collapsed: status dot, field name, value preview, chevron. Expanded:
  - **Value** — the extracted value, marked ✦.
  - **Reasoning** — one short paragraph, collapsible.
  - **Evidence** — one or more verbatim quotes with an accent rule on the left and the hint "Hover to preview · click to view in text", collapsible.
  - **Actions** — Pending: Dismiss / Accept. Accepted: Undo. Dismissed: Restore.
- **Footer** — a full-width "Apply all pending (N)" button, which becomes "All fields reviewed" when nothing is pending.

## Behavior
- Every field starts pending unless the host already knows otherwise (e.g. accepted in an earlier session).
- One card is open at a time. Opening another closes the previous one.
- Accept and Dismiss change the dot, the tab counts and the status bar together; segments animate to their new widths.
- Restore and Undo both return a field to pending. Nothing is final until the host saves.
- Under a status tab, a field whose status changes leaves the list with a short exit animation, so the user sees where it went.
- "Apply all pending" accepts only pending fields. Dismissed fields stay dismissed.
- Hovering or focusing a quote previews it: the matching passage is highlighted in the source. Leaving clears the preview. Clicking pins the highlight and scrolls the source to it.
- Evidence must be a verbatim substring of the source. Drop any quote the host can't find in the source before passing it in, rather than highlighting the wrong passage.
- Search and the tab filter combine. An empty result says what was searched ("No fields match 'date'").

## Content guidelines
- Field names are the reviewer's vocabulary ("Degree of binding force"), sentence case.
- Values are short and normalized: dates in one format, enums from the field's allowed list.
- Reasoning is one to three sentences, cites what in the text decided it, and states doubt plainly ("It may not count as a consultation deadline") rather than hedging every value.
- Quotes are the shortest passage that supports the value — a clause, not a paragraph.
- Count, don't celebrate: "6 of 8 reviewed", "Apply all pending (3)".

## Accessibility
- Filter tabs are a `tablist` with roving focus; ←/→ move between them.
- Each card header is a button inside a heading, with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`; the status is in its accessible name, so color is never the only signal.
- The status bar has a text alternative ("5 accepted, 2 pending, 1 dismissed").
- Each quote is a button labelled "View in source: <quote>". Focus triggers the same preview as hover.
- Status changes and "Apply all" are announced in a polite live region.
- With `prefers-reduced-motion`, cards fade instead of expanding and the bar jumps to its new widths.

## Related patterns
- **AI Fill Drawer** — Use it instead when values fill empty record fields from the web rather than coming from one document.
- **Inline Citation** — Use it instead when the source links belong inside generated prose rather than beside extracted values.
- **Confidence Indicator** — Use it as well next to a value when the model reports how sure it is.
- **Human in the Loop Question** — Use it instead when a single agent action needs approval rather than a set of values.

## Default implementation (Tailwind v4 + Radix + Motion)

This is the catalogue's own reference implementation — use it verbatim when the
host project has no established design system, or when the user asks for
"the demoed look." When the host project has its own design system, treat
this code as a translation reference: keep every rule from the spec above
(Anatomy, Behavior, Content guidelines, Accessibility) and re-express the
markup, styling, and motion using that system's own components/tokens
instead of copying these Tailwind classes or the Motion API.

```tsx
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { AnimatePresence, motion, useReducedMotion } from "motion/react";
import { ArrowUpRight, Check, ChevronDown, Eye, RotateCcw, Search, Sparkles, X, Zap } from "lucide-react";

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export type ReviewStatus = "pending" | "accepted" | "dismissed";

export interface Evidence {
  id: string;
  /** The exact passage the value was extracted from. */
  quote: string;
}

export interface ReviewField {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  /** The value the model extracted. */
  value: string;
  /** Why the model chose this value — one short paragraph. */
  reasoning: string;
  evidence: Evidence[];
  /** Starting status. Defaults to "pending". */
  status?: ReviewStatus;
}

export interface AiReviewPanelProps {
  fields: ReviewField[];
  title?: string;
  /** Fires on every accept, dismiss, restore or undo — and once per field on "Apply all". */
  onStatusChange?: (key: string, status: ReviewStatus) => void;
  /** Hover / focus on a quote: highlight it in the source. `null` clears. */
  onEvidencePreview?: (evidence: Evidence | null) => void;
  /** Click on a quote: scroll the source to it. */
  onEvidenceOpen?: (evidence: Evidence) => void;
  onViewSource?: () => void;
  onClose?: () => void;
  className?: string;
}

type Filter = "all" | ReviewStatus;

const STATUS: Record<
  ReviewStatus,
  { label: string; dot: string; bar: string; badge: string }
> = {
  dismissed: {
    label: "Dismissed",
    dot: "bg-red-500",
    bar: "bg-red-500",
    badge: "bg-red-500/10 text-red-600 dark:text-red-400",
  },
  pending: {
    label: "Pending",
    dot: "bg-amber-500",
    bar: "bg-amber-500",
    badge: "bg-amber-500/15 text-amber-700 dark:text-amber-400",
  },
  accepted: {
    label: "Accepted",
    dot: "bg-emerald-500",
    bar: "bg-emerald-500",
    badge: "bg-emerald-500/15 text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400",
  },
};

const FILTERS: Filter[] = ["all", "pending", "accepted", "dismissed"];

export function AiReviewPanel({
  fields,
  title = "AI Review",
  onStatusChange,
  onEvidencePreview,
  onEvidenceOpen,
  onViewSource,
  onClose,
  className,
}: AiReviewPanelProps) {
  const reduceMotion = useReducedMotion();
  const [status, setStatus] = React.useState<Record<string, ReviewStatus>>(() =>
    Object.fromEntries(fields.map((f) => [f.key, f.status ?? "pending"]))
  );
  const [filter, setFilter] = React.useState<Filter>("all");
  const [query, setQuery] = React.useState("");
  const [expanded, setExpanded] = React.useState<string | null>(null);
  const [announcement, setAnnouncement] = React.useState("");
  const tabRefs = React.useRef<Record<string, HTMLButtonElement | null>>({});
  const listId = React.useId();

  const counts = React.useMemo(() => {
    const c = { all: fields.length, pending: 0, accepted: 0, dismissed: 0 };
    for (const f of fields) c[status[f.key]] += 1;
    return c;
  }, [fields, status]);

  const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
  const visible = fields.filter(
    (f) =>
      (filter === "all" || status[f.key] === filter) &&
      (!q || f.label.toLowerCase().includes(q) || f.value.toLowerCase().includes(q))
  );

  function set(key: string, next: ReviewStatus) {
    setStatus((s) => ({ ...s, [key]: next }));
    onStatusChange?.(key, next);
    const label = fields.find((f) => f.key === key)?.label ?? key;
    setAnnouncement(`${label} ${next === "pending" ? "moved back to pending" : next}`);
  }

  function applyAll() {
    const pending = fields.filter((f) => status[f.key] === "pending");
    setStatus((s) => ({ ...s, ...Object.fromEntries(pending.map((f) => [f.key, "accepted" as const])) }));
    pending.forEach((f) => onStatusChange?.(f.key, "accepted"));
    setAnnouncement(`${pending.length} field${pending.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} accepted`);
  }

  function onTabKey(e: React.KeyboardEvent, i: number) {
    const dir = e.key === "ArrowRight" ? 1 : e.key === "ArrowLeft" ? -1 : 0;
    if (!dir) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const next = FILTERS[(i + dir + FILTERS.length) % FILTERS.length];
    setFilter(next);
    tabRefs.current[next]?.focus();
  }

  return (
    <aside
      aria-label={title}
      className={cn(
        "flex h-full w-full max-w-sm flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-xl border bg-background text-sm shadow-sm",
        className
      )}
    >
      <header className="flex items-center gap-2 px-4 pb-2 pt-3.5">
        <Sparkles className="size-4 text-violet-500" aria-hidden />
        <h2 className="flex-1 font-medium">{title}</h2>
        {onViewSource && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onViewSource}
            className="flex h-7 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md px-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-accent hover:text-foreground"
          >
            <Eye className="size-3.5" aria-hidden />
            View source
          </button>
        )}
        {onClose && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            aria-label="Close"
            className="flex size-7 items-center justify-center rounded-md text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-accent hover:text-foreground"
          >
            <X className="size-4" />
          </button>
        )}
      </header>

      {/* Progress: one segment per status, sized by share of fields */}
      <div className="px-4 pb-3">
        <div className="mb-1.5 flex items-baseline justify-between">
          <span className="text-xs font-medium">Status</span>
          <span className="text-xs tabular-nums text-muted-foreground">
            {counts.accepted + counts.dismissed} of {counts.all} reviewed
          </span>
        </div>
        <div
          role="img"
          aria-label={`${counts.accepted} accepted, ${counts.pending} pending, ${counts.dismissed} dismissed`}
          className="flex h-1.5 gap-0.5"
        >
          {(["dismissed", "pending", "accepted"] as const).map((s) => (
            <motion.span
              key={s}
              className={cn("h-full rounded-full", STATUS[s].bar)}
              initial={false}
              animate={{ flexGrow: counts[s], opacity: counts[s] ? 1 : 0 }}
              style={{ flexBasis: 0 }}
              transition={reduceMotion ? { duration: 0 } : { type: "spring", stiffness: 260, damping: 30 }}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      <div role="tablist" aria-label="Filter by status" className="flex border-b px-1.5">
        {FILTERS.map((f, i) => {
          const active = filter === f;
          return (
            <button
              key={f}
              ref={(el) => {
                tabRefs.current[f] = el;
              }}
              type="button"
              role="tab"
              aria-selected={active}
              aria-controls={listId}
              tabIndex={active ? 0 : -1}
              onClick={() => setFilter(f)}
              onKeyDown={(e) => onTabKey(e, i)}
              className={cn(
                "relative flex flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-1 whitespace-nowrap px-1 py-2 text-xs transition-colors",
                active ? "font-medium text-foreground" : "text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
              )}
            >
              {f === "all" ? "All" : STATUS[f].label}
              <span
                className={cn(
                  "min-w-4.5 rounded-full px-1 py-px text-center text-[11px] tabular-nums",
                  f === "all" ? "bg-muted text-muted-foreground" : STATUS[f].badge
                )}
              >
                {counts[f]}
              </span>
              {active && (
                <motion.span
                  layoutId={`${listId}-tab`}
                  className="absolute inset-x-1 -bottom-px h-0.5 rounded-full bg-foreground"
                  transition={reduceMotion ? { duration: 0 } : { type: "spring", stiffness: 500, damping: 40 }}
                />
              )}
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      <div className="px-3 py-2.5">
        <label className="flex h-8 items-center gap-2 rounded-md border bg-background px-2.5 focus-within:ring-2 focus-within:ring-ring/40">
          <Search className="size-3.5 text-muted-foreground" aria-hidden />
          <input
            value={query}
            onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Search fields…"
            aria-label="Search fields"
            className="min-w-0 flex-1 bg-transparent text-sm outline-none placeholder:text-muted-foreground"
          />
        </label>
      </div>

      <div id={listId} role="tabpanel" className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto px-3 pb-3">
        <AnimatePresence initial={false} mode="popLayout">
          {visible.map((f) => (
            <motion.div
              key={f.key}
              layout={!reduceMotion}
              initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 6 }}
              animate={{ opacity: 1, y: 0 }}
              exit={{ opacity: 0, scale: 0.98 }}
              transition={{ duration: 0.18 }}
              className="mb-1.5"
            >
              <FieldCard
                field={f}
                status={status[f.key]}
                open={expanded === f.key}
                onToggle={() => setExpanded((k) => (k === f.key ? null : f.key))}
                onSet={(s) => set(f.key, s)}
                onEvidencePreview={onEvidencePreview}
                onEvidenceOpen={onEvidenceOpen}
              />
            </motion.div>
          ))}
        </AnimatePresence>
        {visible.length === 0 && (
          <p className="px-2 py-8 text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {q ? `No fields match “${query.trim()}”` : filter === "pending" ? "Nothing left to review" : "No fields here yet"}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>

      <footer className="border-t px-3 py-3">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={applyAll}
          disabled={counts.pending === 0}
          className="flex h-9 w-full items-center justify-center gap-1.5 rounded-md bg-primary text-xs font-medium text-primary-foreground transition-opacity hover:opacity-90 disabled:opacity-40"
        >
          {counts.pending > 0 ? (
            <>
              <Zap className="size-3.5" aria-hidden />
              Apply all pending ({counts.pending})
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <Check className="size-3.5" aria-hidden />
              All fields reviewed
            </>
          )}
        </button>
      </footer>

      <span className="sr-only" role="status" aria-live="polite">
        {announcement}
      </span>
    </aside>
  );
}

function FieldCard({
  field,
  status,
  open,
  onToggle,
  onSet,
  onEvidencePreview,
  onEvidenceOpen,
}: {
  field: ReviewField;
  status: ReviewStatus;
  open: boolean;
  onToggle: () => void;
  onSet: (s: ReviewStatus) => void;
  onEvidencePreview?: (e: Evidence | null) => void;
  onEvidenceOpen?: (e: Evidence) => void;
}) {
  const reduceMotion = useReducedMotion();
  const bodyId = React.useId();

  return (
    <div className={cn("overflow-hidden rounded-lg transition-colors", open ? "bg-muted/60" : "hover:bg-muted/40")}>
      <h3>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onToggle}
          aria-expanded={open}
          aria-controls={bodyId}
          className="flex w-full items-center gap-2.5 px-3 py-2.5 text-left"
        >
          <span className={cn("size-2 shrink-0 rounded-full transition-colors", STATUS[status].dot)} aria-hidden />
          <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate">{field.label}</span>
          <span className="sr-only">, {STATUS[status].label}</span>
          {!open && (
            <span className="max-w-[40%] truncate text-xs text-muted-foreground">{field.value}</span>
          )}
          <ChevronDown
            className={cn("size-4 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground transition-transform", open && "rotate-180")}
            aria-hidden
          />
        </button>
      </h3>

      <AnimatePresence initial={false}>
        {open && (
          <motion.div
            id={bodyId}
            initial={reduceMotion ? { opacity: 0 } : { height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
            animate={reduceMotion ? { opacity: 1 } : { height: "auto", opacity: 1 }}
            exit={reduceMotion ? { opacity: 0 } : { height: 0, opacity: 0 }}
            transition={{ duration: 0.2, ease: [0.2, 0, 0, 1] }}
          >
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 px-2 pb-2">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-md border bg-background px-3 py-2">
                <Sparkles className="size-3.5 shrink-0 text-violet-500" aria-hidden />
                <span className="font-medium">Value</span>
                <span className="min-w-0 flex-1 truncate text-right text-muted-foreground">{field.value}</span>
              </div>

              <Section title="Reasoning">
                <p className="leading-relaxed text-foreground/90">{field.reasoning}</p>
              </Section>

              {field.evidence.length > 0 && (
                <Section title="Evidence">
                  <ul className="flex flex-col gap-1.5">
                    {field.evidence.map((ev) => (
                      <li key={ev.id}>
                        <button
                          type="button"
                          onMouseEnter={() => onEvidencePreview?.(ev)}
                          onMouseLeave={() => onEvidencePreview?.(null)}
                          onFocus={() => onEvidencePreview?.(ev)}
                          onBlur={() => onEvidencePreview?.(null)}
                          onClick={() => onEvidenceOpen?.(ev)}
                          aria-label={`View in source: ${ev.quote}`}
                          className="group w-full rounded-md bg-muted/60 py-2 pl-2 pr-3 text-left transition-colors hover:bg-violet-500/10"
                        >
                          <span className="block border-l-2 border-violet-500 pl-3 leading-relaxed">“{ev.quote}”</span>
                          <span className="mt-1.5 flex items-center gap-1 pl-3.5 text-[11px] text-violet-600 dark:text-violet-400">
                            <ArrowUpRight className="size-3" aria-hidden />
                            Hover to preview · click to view in text
                          </span>
                        </button>
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                </Section>
              )}

              <div className="flex justify-end gap-1.5 pt-0.5">
                {status === "pending" ? (
                  <>
                    <ActionButton onClick={() => onSet("dismissed")}>
                      <X className="size-3.5" aria-hidden />
                      Dismiss
                    </ActionButton>
                    <ActionButton primary onClick={() => onSet("accepted")}>
                      <Check className="size-3.5" aria-hidden />
                      Accept
                    </ActionButton>
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <ActionButton onClick={() => onSet("pending")}>
                    <RotateCcw className="size-3.5" aria-hidden />
                    {status === "dismissed" ? "Restore" : "Undo"}
                  </ActionButton>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </motion.div>
        )}
      </AnimatePresence>
    </div>
  );
}

function Section({ title, children }: { title: string; children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const [open, setOpen] = React.useState(true);
  const id = React.useId();
  return (
    <div className="rounded-md border bg-background">
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={() => setOpen((o) => !o)}
        aria-expanded={open}
        aria-controls={id}
        className="flex w-full items-center gap-2 px-3 py-2 text-left"
      >
        <Sparkles className="size-3.5 shrink-0 text-violet-500" aria-hidden />
        <span className="flex-1 font-medium">{title}</span>
        <ChevronDown
          className={cn("size-4 text-muted-foreground transition-transform", !open && "-rotate-90")}
          aria-hidden
        />
      </button>
      {open && (
        <div id={id} className="px-3 pb-3">
          {children}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function ActionButton({
  primary,
  onClick,
  children,
}: {
  primary?: boolean;
  onClick: () => void;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={onClick}
      className={cn(
        "flex h-8 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-md px-3 text-xs font-medium transition-colors",
        primary
          ? "bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:opacity-90"
          : "border bg-background hover:bg-accent"
      )}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}
```
